summary: Adds an email search filter to the users index, a self-service profile update, and a destroy action. It also adds a welcome email sent after each User save.

findings.title: SQL injection in email search
findings.problem: The index action interpolates params[:q] directly into the where SQL string. Any authenticated caller controls the query text.
findings.consequence: An authenticated user can read any column of any table, including api_token values. That user can then impersonate admins.
findings.fix: Pass params[:q] as a bound parameter and escape LIKE wildcards with sanitize_sql_like.

findings.title: Destroy action exempted from admin check
findings.problem: The change adds destroy to the except list of require_admin. The destroy action then deletes any user by id without an ownership check.
findings.consequence: Any authenticated user can delete every account, including admin accounts.
findings.fix: Remove destroy from the except list so only admins can delete users.

findings.title: Mass assignment in profile update
findings.problem: The profile action permits every user attribute from the request without a filter list. A caller can set admin or api_token on their own record.
findings.consequence: Any authenticated user can make themselves an admin. That user then gains every admin-only action.
findings.fix: Permit only the editable profile fields, such as email.

findings.title: Welcome email sent on every save
findings.problem: The after_save callback runs on every create and every update. Each profile update sends another welcome email.
findings.consequence: Users receive repeated welcome emails whenever their record changes.
findings.fix: Use after_create_commit so the email goes out once, after the record is committed.

findings.title: New controller behaviour has no covering test
findings.problem: The change adds search, profile and destroy behaviour but no test. The repository contains no test files covering these actions.
findings.consequence: Regressions in authorization and filtering can ship unnoticed.
findings.fix: Add request tests for search, profile updates and destroy authorization.
